Date Played: 2026-03-14

Recap-Teaser

Five heralds stood in the Shrine of Renewal and felt the world try to knit itself back together — cracks sealing, moss pushing through marble, torchlight burning clean and white for the first time in weeks. Five out of six. Close enough to taste what wholeness feels like, and nowhere near enough to hold it. The sixth is Count Albrecht Marrow, the man who started all of this, and he is somewhere above them in a golden city that is eating itself alive. Edric is gone — vanished mid-step beneath an invisibility spell, swallowed by the dark under the Chryseum without a sound. Three heralds of ruin where there should be four, and the pattern will not hold with pieces missing.

Above, Aurelion shudders. The Order of the Eclipsed Sword has ridden through the gates — not city guards, not golden-armored Aureate, but the Church of Lucifer's own blade, come to arrest the very man the heralds need most. Roderic knows their banners. He rode under one, once. And now he must decide what his faith demands: obedience to the order that raised him, or loyalty to a mission that his god may have set in motion. Old Garland felt his spellbook stir in the shrine, pages thickening, ink darkening — the first proof that what the forgetting stole might be returned. He will not let that hope die in a jurisdictional dispute between priests.

And somewhere in the tunnels, Castor can feel the foundations groaning. Stone remembers what stood here before the church was built. Stone remembers what sleeps below. The God of Renewal waits in its cocoon, patient as roots beneath winter soil — but winter does not last forever, and the Laughing One is already placing bets on what blooms when it breaks.

Summary

The party split at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} beneath the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum}.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} remained behind to commune with the dormant The God of Renewal, feeling an overwhelming sense of homecoming as the presence within the cocoon recognized him and embraced him with warmth, flooding his mind with half-forgotten memories of his grandmother telling stories of the old gods.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}, and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} departed through the tunnels toward @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion} to retrieve @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} — the sixth and final herald needed to complete the balance.

At @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion}, the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} had breached the castle, and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{First Aureate Dorn} was leading the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aureate} in a desperate defense.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} stayed in the tunnels to avoid arrest, while @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} navigated the besieged castle alone.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} drew on centuries-old memories of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s conquest of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion} to guide them through a secret passage connecting the castle vault to the count's private chambers.
They bluffed past Aureate guards with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}'s @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{whiteglass} pendant, reached @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}, and convinced the reluctant count to accompany them — arguing that ruin and renewal must be balanced by gathering all heralds together.

Meanwhile, the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} appeared in the Shrine and confronted @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} directly, claiming the The Laughing One was responsible for his original beaver curse and attempting to recruit him.
When @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} touched the cocoon despite the Harlequin's warning, he received a vision from Renewal showing him as a protector — a crucial piece of the balance.
The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} attacked, but @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} shifted into a wolverine and drove it off.

The escape through the vault turned violent when @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} soldiers descended on the party.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} bowled the lead soldiers down a ramp while @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} cut through another with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.fzOZlON1IXqDDZCh]{Second Harvest}, and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow} sealed the vault door behind them.
A @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Corona Vigil} inquisitor branded them heretics, but the party pressed on and reunited with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} in the tunnels.

Returning to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum}, they found it overrun — @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Harlequins} dancing with religious artifacts, grieving people destroying property, and a murdered @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} paladin lying stripped on the steps.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic}'s divine decree scattered the mob, but the Harlequins remained, with the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} puppeteering the dead paladin's corpse in a grotesque display.
The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} locked eyes with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} and projected a disturbing vision that seeded doubt about @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow}'s true intentions.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} charged through the lesser Harlequins and beheaded the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} in a single devastating strike, while @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} eliminated the rest.

The party descended to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} where @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} waited in beaver form behind a barricade he had built.
With all six heralds gathered around the cocoon, the ruinous energy flowed out of the heralds of ruin, merged with the renewal energy, and the cocoon opened — releasing a spring-like surge that transformed the desiccated chamber into a verdant, living space.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} used Eyes of the Faithful to confirm that @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and the followers of renewal were sincere, dispelling the doubt the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} had planted.

Major Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} remained at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} and communed with the dormant The God of Renewal — the presence within the cocoon recognized him as a herald of ruin and embraced him with warmth, flooding his mind with half-forgotten memories of his grandmother telling stories of the old gods as partners of mortals.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}, and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} emerged from the tunnels near @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion} to hear the sounds of battle — the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} had breached the castle. Severin and Brenn stayed behind to avoid arrest.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} spotted @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{First Aureate Dorn} and his guards fighting Order soldiers in the courtyard and chose to bypass the battle to reach @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow}.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} presented @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}'s @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{whiteglass} pendant to convince Aureate guards they had been sent to retrieve the Count, then @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} used his veteran's authority to compel the guards to stand aside.
  • Inside the vault, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} noted immense piles of gold — though notably less than centuries ago — and led @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} through a secret passage to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow}'s private chambers, where they convinced the reluctant count to join them.
  • The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} appeared at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} and confronted @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor}, claiming the The Laughing One was responsible for his original beaver curse and attempting to recruit him into a partnership of building and laughter.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} touched the cocoon and received a vision from Renewal showing him calming a crowd and protecting the dormant god — confirming his role as a crucial protector of the balance. The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} attacked, but @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} shifted into a wolverine and drove it off.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} soldiers descended on the party in the vault. @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} shield-kicked the lead soldier down a ramp while @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} struck another with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.fzOZlON1IXqDDZCh]{Second Harvest}. A @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Corona Vigil} inquisitor branded them heretics, but @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow} sealed the vault door and they escaped into the tunnels.
  • The party reunited with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} in the tunnels. Severin and Marrow shared a warm embrace.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} fortified the Shrine entrance in beaver form, building a dam-like barricade. He overheard @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Harlequins} interrogating and killing an @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the First Dawn} paladin above him.
  • At the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum}, the party found the temple in chaos — @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Harlequins} dancing with artifacts, grieving people destroying property, and a murdered paladin on the steps. @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic}'s divine decree scattered the mob.
  • The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} puppeteered the dead paladin's corpse, then locked eyes with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} and projected a disturbing vision seeding doubt about @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Marrow}. Roderic charged through the lesser Harlequins and beheaded the Dark Harlequin in a single devastating strike, while @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.wE046R3Drp0snmvQ]{Brenn} eliminated the rest.
  • All six heralds gathered at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal}. The ruinous energy flowed from the heralds of ruin, combined with renewal energy, and the cocoon opened — releasing a spring-like surge that transformed the chamber into a verdant, living space.
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} used Eyes of the Faithful to confirm that @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} and the followers of renewal were sincere, dispelling the doubt planted by the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin}.

New Questions & Hooks

  • Was the The Laughing One truly responsible for @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor}'s original beaver curse, or was the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin} lying?

Questions Answered / Arcs Advanced

  • Curse of Ruin: The party retrieved @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Marrow}, gathered all six heralds, and opened the cocoon — releasing the The God of Renewal and restoring balance within the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal}.
  • Roderic — Redemption: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} articulated a nuanced theology positioning ruin and renewal as forces of nature subordinate to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Lucifer}, confronted a @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Corona Vigil} inquisitor, defeated the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jB7eRLPu6CNxnyYm]{The Dark Harlequin}, and used Eyes of the Faithful to confirm the followers of renewal are sincere.

Notable NPCs Introduced

None

Notable Locations Visited

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} — ancient chamber beneath the Chryseum where the God of Renewal's cocoon rests
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion} — besieged by the Order of the Eclipsed Sword
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{The Chryseum} — overrun by Harlequins and rioters

Notable Quotes

"I don't consider ruin and renewal to be gods. I think of them as forces of nature. Nature is separate from gods. Lucifer is above them, but they are something that needs to exist in the world."
— Roderic, articulating his theological position on ruin and renewal
"While some people are ignorant to think that they are gods, I don't think that they are wrong to think that they need to exist."
— Roderic, acknowledging a middle ground between heresy and orthodoxy
"I think the best joke was letting you turn into a beaver. Why a beaver? Why not a lion? Why not a cat? A beaver? Really? You don't see the humor in that?"
— The Dark Harlequin, claiming the Laughing One was responsible for Castor's original curse
"I'll have you know that my life as a beaver has been studious and fulfilling, and I don't find it funny at all. I think it's quite the noble creature."
— Castor, defending his beaver existence to the Dark Harlequin
"And that is the punchline."
— The Dark Harlequin, responding to Castor's earnest defense of beaver-hood
"We don't have time for explanation, son. You're going to move out of the way or you're not."
— Garland, threatening the Aureate guard blocking the vault entrance
"You brought ruin to this place and now you're trying to bring me to the temple. Why should I go with you?"
— Count Marrow, confronting the party about their role as heralds of ruin
"I am not speaking for Lucifer. Lucifer speaks through me."
— Roderic, responding to the Corona Vigil inquisitor's dismissal in the Aurelion Vault
"You have disrespected our Lord Lucifer and destroyed one of his paladins. Anyone who does not leave this temple immediately shall be put down by my sword."
— Roderic, divine decree clearing the Chryseum of rioters
"It's been a rough day, nephew."
— Castor, in beaver form, greeting the party after they descend to the shrine

Session Notes

  • The GM designed the Shrine communion specifically to give Castor a significant character beat after being underserved in recent sessions while stuck in mouse/beaver form.
  • Sessions 1-5 are treated as prologue, with the "real game" starting from the next session onward.
